tagline: A quiet residential district on the far Asian side near Kartal — close to the sea, well connected by metro, and increasingly popular with families priced out of more central neighbourhoods.

items.name: Kartal Sahili (yakın)
items.description: The Kartal waterfront park and marina are minutes away — a good seafront escape with views of the Princes' Islands and the open Marmara.

items.name: Yakacık Semt Parkı
items.description: A neighbourhood park popular with families and morning joggers — green and well-maintained.

items.name: Yakacık Merkez Kafeleri
items.description: Neighbourhood cafés around the Yakacık centre — unpretentious and local, with outdoor seating in good weather.

items.name: Semt Lokantalari
items.description: Affordable lokanta restaurants serving daily menus of traditional Turkish food. Solid and unpretentious.

tips: Yakacık is close to Kartal metro station on the M4 line — Kadıköy is around 25 minutes.
Very affordable rents by Istanbul standards — a practical choice for the Asian side.
The nearby Kartal waterfront is a bonus that most residents take full advantage of.
Pendik and its airport connections are also easily reachable from here.
